name: generation_change_replace
comment: generation change (consumer-level concept, e.g. datascad's query generation): a subscriber caught up on version=1 is woken by a replace carrying a NEW opaque payload representing the next generation. taut-shape has no generation concept of its own -- this is an ordinary replace like any other; the held read is released exactly as ordinary_replace releases it. The consumer decides from the (opaque) payload contents whether the generation it just received is compatible with what it expected; an incompatible generation is a consumer-level decision to end the stream (AtomEndStream) and re-establish a fresh subscription -- both ordinary AtomEndStream + AtomReadRequest, no new taut-shape mechanism (see dev-docs/AtomSwmrNotes.md).
